content_zh:
前方的景象一变，灯光明亮，全是开启的汽车大灯，而在街道两侧，则是停着不少汽车，不下五十辆，其中有改装车，也有超跑。
“飙车党！”
陈阳眉毛一挑，顿时知道旁边驾驶席这位哥特妹是干什么的了，难怪会如此暴力改装一辆车，原来是飙车一族。
聂伊辰似乎在飙车圈子里有些名气，她的老捷达一到，立即吸引了全场的目光，在场的男男女女都朝这边围了过来。
聂伊辰开门下车，一名面色冷峻的年轻人笑了声，用力一拍老捷达的引擎盖，大声道：“离我们约定的时间过了十分钟，我还以为聂大小姐怕了，不敢来应战。”
“李恒江，我聂伊辰怕谁也不会怕你。”聂伊辰和那叫李恒江的男子争锋相对，冷哼一声道：“少废话，准备好了没有，准备好了就开始比赛。”
“当然准备好了，你今天就等着输吧。”
李恒江冷笑一声，手抬起往后招了招，一名穿着赛车服，表情冷酷的男子从人群中走了出来。
“川介雄一。”看到出现的男子，聂伊辰面色一变，指着李恒江道：“李恒江，你太无耻了，竟然找专业车手，而且还是个RB人！”
“我们约战的时候，可没说一定要本人驾驶赛车，难道你怕了？”李恒江耸了耸肩，得意地看着聂伊辰，冷笑道：“如果你怕了，那你就认输，一百万赌金我不要，你叫我一声好哥哥就行。”
听到这话，李恒江身后的跟班很配合地哄笑起来。
聂伊辰咬了咬牙，硬气道：“一个小RB，我会怕他，来吧，开始比赛。”
“等等。”
李恒江制止了准备坐回车上的聂伊辰，一脸嚣张，拍了拍手掌，大声喊道：“把我今天的战车开出来。”
嗡嗡嗡……
激昂的排气声在人群后面响起，人群散开，一辆帅气的超跑缓缓开过来，在距离老捷达车头前不到五厘米的距离停下。
“兰博基尼埃文塔多……”
看着眼前的超跑，聂伊辰的面色更难看了，她的老捷达虽然改装得非常牛叉，但和真正的超跑大牛比起来，还是有不小的差距，加上对方有职业车手驾驶，今天这场比赛，她几乎没有胜算了。
聂伊辰狠狠地瞪着李恒江，气呼呼道：“李恒江，你还要不要脸，有种你自己开你的M3和我比赛。”
“哟，生气了？害怕了？”李恒江恬不知耻地笑了笑，道：“有本事你也可以找驾驶员，你也可以换车，我没阻止你呀。”

聂伊辰气得浑身颤抖，她喜欢车，是为了自己的信仰和荣誉而战，那种找帮手、换好车的行径，在她看来是一种侮辱，她是绝对不屑去做的。
就在这时，李恒江身旁一名穿着性感暴露的女子指着坐在副驾的陈阳，嘲讽道：“快看，原来聂大小姐请了帮手，难道这是哪位隐姓埋名的车神？”
众人顺着女子的手指看去，顿时哄堂大笑起来，因为副驾的男子怎么看都不像一位赛车高手。
聂伊辰看了眼陈阳，觉得有些对不住陈阳，心想早知道就不带他来，这下不止自己丢脸，连带着陈阳也被羞辱。
副驾驶的门缓缓女子，正色道：“姑娘果然好眼力，我隐藏得这么深都被你看了出来，没错，我就是高柳山车神，绰号高柳飞车王。”
听到这话，全场都是一愣，目光刷的聚集在陈阳的身上，虽然大家都没听过高柳山，但既然对方号称高柳山车神，那就肯定不是泛泛之辈。
聂伊辰目光一亮，失落的心顿时燃起了一丝期望，联想到陈阳坐车时的淡定，心想自己难道真这么好运，遇到了高手？
就在李恒江皱眉，聂伊辰心喜之时，陈阳脸上露出回忆的神采道：“想当年我在高柳山，阿飞和阿嘎都不是我的对手，每次都被我远远甩在身后，一骑绝尘。我的那辆车，我也十分怀念，那纯猪皮的把手，二八的大钢圈，只补过十七次的轮胎，是多么的潇洒，多么……”
李恒江嘴角一抽，制止了陈阳继续说下去，问道：“等等，你开的是什么车？”
陈阳挺了挺胸，一脸高傲：“没错，我那辆车，就是六八年产的经典款凤凰牌二八大杠。哈哈哈，你们是不是很羡慕！”

content_en:
The scene ahead changed, the lights were bright, all were turned on car headlights, and on both sides of the street, there were many cars parked, no less than fifty, including modified cars and supercars.
"Racing Party!"
Chen Yang raised his eyebrows and immediately knew what the goth girl in the driver's seat next to her did. No wonder she would modify a car so violently. It turned out to be a racing group.
Nie Yichen seems to be well-known in the drag racing circle. As soon as her old Jetta arrived, she immediately attracted the attention of the audience, and all the men and women present gathered around.
Nie Yichen opened the door and got out of the car. A young man with a stern face laughed, slapped the hood of the old Jetta hard, and said loudly: "It's been ten minutes since the time we agreed on. I thought Miss Nie was afraid and didn't dare to challenge."
"Li Hengjiang, I, Nie Yichen, am afraid of no one but you." Nie Yichen confronted the man named Li Hengjiang and snorted coldly: "Stop talking nonsense, are you ready? Let the game start when you are ready."
"Of course I'm ready. Just wait and lose today."
Li Hengjiang sneered, raised his hand and waved back, and a man wearing a racing suit with a cold expression walked out of the crowd.
"Kawasuke Yuichi." Nie Yichen's expression changed when he saw the man appearing. He pointed at Li Hengjiang and said, "Li Hengjiang, you are so shameless. You even found a professional driver, and he is also a RB man!"
"When we made the appointment, we didn't say that I had to drive the racing car. Are you afraid?" Li Hengjiang shrugged, looked at Nie Yichen proudly, and sneered: "If you are afraid, then you have to admit defeat. I don't want a million dollars in bets. Just call me good brother."
Hearing this, the followers behind Li Hengjiang laughed cooperatively.
Nie Yichen gritted his teeth and said firmly: "I'm afraid of a little RB. Come on, let's start the game."
"Wait."
Li Hengjiang stopped Nie Yichen who was about to sit back in the car. With an arrogant look on his face, he clapped his hands and shouted: "Bring out my chariot today."
Buzz buzz...
An exciting exhaust sound sounded from behind the crowd, and the crowd dispersed. A handsome supercar slowly drove over and stopped less than five centimeters in front of the front of the old Jetta.
"Lamborghini Aventador..."
Looking at the supercar in front of her, Nie Yichen's expression became even uglier. Although her old Jetta was very well modified, it still had a big gap compared with the real supercar. Plus, the opponent was driven by a professional driver. She had almost no chance of winning today's competition.
Nie Yichen glared at Li Hengjiang fiercely and said angrily: "Li Hengjiang, are you still shameless? If you dare, drive your M3 to compete with me."
"Hey, are you angry? Scared?" Li Hengjiangtian smiled shamelessly and said, "If you have the ability, you can also find a driver, or you can change cars. I didn't stop you."
Nie Yichen was so angry that she was shaking all over. She liked cars because she fought for her own beliefs and honor. The act of finding helpers and changing cars seemed to her an insult, and she would never bother to do it.
At this moment, a woman wearing sexy and revealing clothes next to Li Hengjiang pointed at Chen Yang who was sitting in the passenger seat and mocked: "Look, it turns out that Miss Nie has hired help. Is this some anonymous car god?"
Everyone looked at the woman's fingers and burst into laughter because the man in the passenger seat didn't look like a racing expert.
Nie Yichen glanced at Chen Yang and felt a little sorry for Chen Yang. He thought that he would not have brought him here if he had known about it. Now he would not only be embarrassed, but Chen Yang would also be humiliated.
The woman opened the passenger door slowly and said sternly: "Girl, you really have good eyesight. You saw me even though I was hiding so deeply. That's right, I am the God of Cars in Gaoliu Mountain, nicknamed the King of Speedy Cars in Gaoliu Mountain."
Hearing this, the whole audience was stunned, and their eyes focused on Chen Yang. Although everyone had never heard of Gao Liushan, since they were familiar with it,Fang is known as the God of Cars in Gaoliushan, so he is definitely not an ordinary person.
Nie Yichen's eyes lit up, and a glimmer of hope suddenly ignited in his disappointed heart. Thinking of Chen Yang's calmness when he was riding in the car, he thought to himself, could he really be so lucky to meet a master?
Just when Li Hengjiang frowned and Nie Yichen was happy, Chen Yang said with a look of memory on his face: "I remember when I was in Gaoliu Mountain, A Fei and A Ga were no match for me, and they were always left far behind by me. I miss my car very much, with its pure pigskin handles, 28-inch large steel rims, and tires that have only been patched seventeen times. How chic and unrestrained it was, how..."
Li Hengjiang twitched the corner of his mouth, stopped Chen Yang from continuing, and asked: "Wait, what kind of car are you driving?"
Chen Yang puffed up his chest and looked arrogant: "That's right, my car is the classic Phoenix brand 28-bar produced in 1968. Hahaha, aren't you very envious!"
